turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm getting my dad a new phone and I want to pick the right one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a simple phone with big buttons and a large screen, made for people who aren't techy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the same brand he's using now, just the newer version, so everything feels familiar.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a cheap basic smartphone that mostly does calls, texts and photos.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sticking with the same brand is probably the smoothest choice, he won't have to relearn anything. The big button phone is great if his eyesight is a concern. The basic smartphone saves money but might feel slow.
